Not run here: Play dev-link walkthrough (result -> Exportar PDF -> PDF salvo -> Fechar; result/home -> Relatórios opens the center on the right diagnosis). Needs the Play desktop app and an integrated build. Deferred to integration.

evidence.detail: no matches (grep exit 1); ResultPage.tsx and ConfidenceNote.tsx no longer reference the removed export
ConfidenceNote.tsx and ResultPage.tsx header meta line use formatConfidenceStatement from shared/format/confidenceText.ts; the local describeConfidence is gone
RiskList.tsx labels 'Probabilidade P de 5', 'Impacto I de 5', 'Nota P × I = N' use whitespace-nowrap; grid is sm:grid-cols-[160px_minmax(0,1fr)]. Visual check at 390/1280 px not run here.

ResultHeader: 'Relatórios' link data-aioson-id=result-reports to /empresa/{companyId}/relatorios?diagnostico={diagnosisId}; ResultExport wraps ReportDelivery onExport=exportReport(diagnosisId), shows result-export-close 'Fechar' only after a successful save and remounts ReportDelivery on close. ReportDelivery catches onExport rejections. OwnerHome.tsx home-reports link to /empresa/{companyId}/relatorios.

messages.text: Run the deferred checks after integration: (1) pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/result.spec.ts tests/e2e/report.spec.ts tests/e2e/accessibility.spec.ts, including the RiskList layout at 390 px and 1280 px for AC-ra-24 and AC-ra-61; (2) Play dev-link walkthrough: open a result -> Exportar PDF (data-aioson-id=report-export) -> PDF salvo (report-pdf-saved) -> Fechar (result-export-close); then result/home -> Relatórios (result-reports / home-reports) opens the center on the right diagnosis.

ConfidenceNote no longer exports describeConfidence; consumers use formatConfidenceStatement from shared/format/confidenceText.ts. src/features/result/ExportReportDialog.tsx is retired and has no importers.
